user.title: Connect controller
user.description: Live local telemetry and controls over a persistent connection. Connections may re-enable smart timers. Password authentication is not supported.

data.acknowledge_timer_effect: I understand connections may re-enable smart timers

reconfigure.title: Change connection
reconfigure.description: Connect to the same physical controller at its new address.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot read the controller. Check network access and controller availability.
error.unsupported_authentication: Password authentication is not yet supported.
error.acknowledgment_required: Acknowledge the possible timer effect before connecting.

init.title: Flow meter calibration
init.description: Select the installed meter to estimate flow in US gallons per minute. Leave unknown until the physical meter is confirmed. The raw pulse count remains available.

data_description.flow_meter: Leridian rates both calibrations to ±10% at the default 75 cs counting window. The integration adjusts for the controller's current Flow Meter Delay.
